verdict.rationale: Spline documents webhooks, but they are inbound: a scene listens for external events and reacts by triggering actions or updating variables. Outbound, event-driven calls are possible only through the scene-level Real-time API, so this is not a conventional way to subscribe to platform events such as file or editor changes. Missing for 10: outbound webhook subscriptions to Spline platform or file events, delivery details (payloads, retries, signing), and independent hands-on corroboration.
